description: Use when the user asks what changed on one lead. Pass opportunity_id from list_opportunities or get_daily_brief (eop_...). Returns whether the lead is watched and up to 20 dated before/after changes with sources. Saved evidence only: no new research and no notification.

opportunity_id.description: The lead id (starts with eop_) from list_opportunities or get_daily_brief.

name: get_project_updates

active.description: Whether the lead is being watched.

baseline.description: The saved snapshot changes are compared against, or null when never watched.

title: Read changes on a lead
